Play in 3D Guides and tools (ID)

About MyFarmTwin

MyFarmTwin is a free 3D farming game set among rice fields in tropical Indonesia. You can play in English or Indonesian on a browser that supports WebGL 2.

Life on the farm

Start with 24 garden beds and grow lettuce, tomatoes, and corn. Open animal areas as you go, care for chickens, goats, cows, or fish, and sell what you produce at the market. Sales pay for buildings and farmhouse upgrades.

The houses draw on Indonesian architecture. Workers move between the garden, livestock pens, pond, and market by day. Street lamps light the village road after dark. Crop growth, animal care, and prices are simplified for play.

Your farm progress

You can play without an account. Progress is saved in your browser, and the Data menu lets you export or import a text backup. You can also open the recovery tool in the same browser if the 3D world is unavailable.

The Indonesian player guide shows the controls, market, building upgrades, and backup steps on desktop and mobile.
